ruleDefinitions.name: Response File Execution Via Odbcconf.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" with the "-f" flag in order to load a response file which might contain a malicious action.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "odbcconf\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-f\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.rsp.*"))
